your_private_thoughts_last_10.thought: End turn with $3,051 cash on Income Tax. I hold Light Blue hotels, two unmortgaged railroads, and blockers on Pink, Red, Yellow (2 of 3), and Green while p1 ($105), p2 ($365), and p3 ($144) remain low on cash. Holding my position without trading is optimal.

Reject p2's offer. I already own Pennsylvania Avenue to block the Green monopoly, and North Carolina Avenue is mortgaged. Keeping p2 at $40 cash leaves them on the brink of bankruptcy right as they approach my Light Blue hotels.
Reject p2's offer of mortgaged Electric Company for $40. I don't need a singleton mortgaged utility, and keeping p2 low on cash as they approach the first side of the board is better.
Unmortgage Electric Company for $83. With $3,349 in cash, activating it to collect 4x dice rent from cash-strapped p1 ($105) and p3 ($271) is well worth the small cost.

End turn with $3,266 cash on Just Visiting. I hold Light Blue hotels, two unmortgaged railroads, unmortgaged Electric Company, and blockers on Pink, Red, Yellow (2 of 3), and Green while p1 ($105) and p3 ($271) remain low on cash. Holding my position without trading is optimal.

Counter with $350 cash only for Marvin Gardens, keeping Kentucky Avenue so p1 cannot trade it to p3 to complete the Red monopoly. Completing the Yellow monopoly while retaining $2,938 cash allows me to build three Yellow hotels ($2,250) on my next turn with ample cash remaining.

End turn with $3,300 cash on States Avenue. Both p1 ($93) and p3 ($249) are on Ventnor Avenue with low cash, approaching Dark Blues, Browns, and my Light Blue hotels. Keeping p1 cash-starved so they cannot unmortgage New York Avenue or build on Orange is optimal.

Reject p1's offer. Giving p1 $1,200 would allow them to immediately unmortgage New York Avenue ($110) and build houses on their Orange monopoly. Keeping p1 at $93 cash so they cannot activate or develop Orange is strictly optimal.

End turn with $3,300 cash on Free Parking. Both p1 ($93 on Pacific Avenue) and p3 ($249 on North Carolina Avenue) have low cash and are approaching the first side of the board and my Light Blue hotels. Holding my position without trading is optimal.

Roll for doubles rather than paying the $50 fine. All properties are owned and p3 has 2 houses on each Orange property right outside of Jail, while p3 only has $36 cash. Staying in Jail as long as possible to avoid landing on Orange or Dark Blue while collecting rent on my Light Blue hotels is strictly optimal.

notes: If you roll doubles, you immediately leave jail and move normally.
